title: Your Favorites By Request
description: The Apostle Paul reminds us in the New Testament that we are to shine for Christ in a dark and dreary world. Sing along with host Tim Parton and guest Yvonne Lewis-Shelton as they let their lights shine through a few great hymns and spiritual songs from a list of world-wide requests. For a few moments of encouragement and soul-stirring singing, look no further than Your Favorites, By Request. Send your favorite to tim.parton@3abn.org.
